$comment: Limits for tests/middleware-e2e/perf.mjs. The gate fails when a measured value exceeds its limit.
Derivation: `node tests/middleware-e2e/perf.mjs --measure` run 3 times on the host in `measured`; each limit is
max(5 x the largest of the 3 values, floor), rounded up to 2 significant digits. The floor is 25 ms for the HTTP
values only: a small optimize is dominated by the SQLite WAL fsync per commit, which is far slower on CI disks than
on a laptop SSD. The Go benchmark is CPU-bound and has no floor. Re-derive after a deliberate performance change.

p99 is measured and printed but not gated: on a shared or CI host, 100-200 samples swing it several-fold (observed 47 -> 72 ms small, 86 -> 190 ms large at load average 12-18), so a p99 limit fails on noise. Medians and the Go benchmarks gate.

measured.host: Apple M3 Pro, darwin/arm64, go1.26.5, node 22.22.2 (shared with other workloads)
